changes.title: Hit shake
items: The screen shakes when the witch is hit: a jolt on the first hit, harder on the next, and a big thump when she's knocked down. Turn it off on the start screen (screen shake on / off) or with ?shake=0

changes.title: Witch ouch
items: Your witch cries out when she's hurt ("ouch!", "oof!", "eek!"), more strained on her last hit, and lets out a long "whoa-oh" when she's knocked down; the music dips for a moment

changes.title: Lost urgent
items: When losing a soundsystem brings the next wave at once, its sting's clock races faster
